title: Misleading test name: groupfilter_negation_excludes_first_match
description: In crates/core/src/wildmat.rs, the test name 'groupfilter_negation_excludes_first_match' (line 228) is misleading. The test exercises that '\!alt.binaries.*' causes 'alt.binaries.pictures' to be rejected — it is testing negation semantics, not 'first match' semantics. The phrase 'first_match' implies the exclusion is because the negated pattern appears before some other pattern that would have matched; a reader unfamiliar with the filter logic will re-read the filter list trying to understand which first match is being excluded. A name like 'groupfilter_negation_excludes_matching_name' or 'groupfilter_negated_pattern_rejects_group' would be unambiguous.
